# Mermaider source provenance

The sources in this directory are derived from
[`nullean/mermaider`](https://github.com/nullean/mermaider) commit
`fe25845196bf2952b05837fa466e035d59b5f18c`.

They are adapted to target .NET Framework 4.8 for MarkdownView. The upstream
project targets .NET 10. Changes are limited to framework compatibility,
dependency reduction and integration with the WLX plugin.

The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE.txt`.
